title: Update 26.1 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2024 Release Wave 1
summary: Update 26.1 for Business Central 2025 release wave 1 includes hotfixes and new features for e-documents, Copilot testing, sustainability management, and user experience improvements. Use this page to learn what changes are in this update and plan upgrades.
features: Create e-documents from posted sales invoices
Export reminders and finance charges as PEPPOL files
Send e-documents via service and email simultaneously
Use e-documents to fix unposted purchase documents
Water and waste management with sustainability
